rules.title: File larger than the limit
rules.description: A file is larger than layers.walk.maxFileBytes; nobody reviews a file of that size, so its content is not checked by anyone.

rules.title: Bundle larger than the limit
rules.description: The files of the skill add up to more than layers.walk.maxBundleBytes; a bundle of that size is not what a skill needs.

rules.title: More text than the limit
rules.description: The Markdown, code, text and data files of the skill add up to more than layers.walk.maxTextBytes; nobody reads that much before trusting a skill.

rules.title: More files than the limit
rules.description: The skill has more files than layers.walk.maxFiles; a bundle of that many files buries the ones that matter.

rules.title: Directory deeper than the limit
rules.description: A file sits more than layers.walk.maxDepth directories below the skill root; no skill needs a tree that deep, and a deep path keeps a file out of sight.

rules.title: PDF asset
rules.description: The skill ships a PDF file; the scanner cannot check its content as text, and a PDF can carry scripts and instructions a reviewer does not see.
